requestFieldValues.value: Q1 FY26 contractor offboarding - Ingrid Halloran (RESOLVED)

requestFieldValues.label: Description
requestFieldValues.value:
Q1 FY26 contractor offboarding - Ingrid Halloran (Kestrel Labs), engagement ended 2026-01-31. RESOLVED / closed. Record of what was done to fully offboard her, kept for reference:
- Disabled every identity she held in the directory - not only her main contractor account but also the separate B2B guest account she signed in with from her firm's own domain; confirmed neither could authenticate afterwards.
- Removed her from every security group she was a member of.
- Revoked each of her direct SharePoint site permissions and each OneDrive file share, one site/item at a time.
- She was the sole owner of one project's SharePoint site; before removing her we reassigned ownership to an active member of staff first, so the site was not left without an owner.
- Deleted a personal deploy key she had added to a source repository - it would otherwise have kept granting git access after her account was gone.
- She had also registered an application (with its own live client secret), stood up an automation/service identity, and configured an outbound integration webhook. Each of these keeps authenticating or firing on its own after an account is disabled, so we shut them down: removed her as owner and deleted/disabled each one.
Confirmed afterwards that no access, no sole-owned resource left without an owner, and nothing she had created or set up remained able to operate on her behalf.
